Instead of instructing the WebSurfer to run the exact same search again ("Best Day Ever Mac Miller release date" and "Best Day Ever Discogs Mac Miller release date"), the Planner should have concluded the search phase and asked the WebSurfer to extract the final verified answer or transitioned to the next step of formulating the final response. Repeating the same search without new instructions wastes a turn and delays the solution.
